Improved reload and range.

  •  Slightly increases range

This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.desc: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Crossing Over
perks.desc: This weapon has increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal increased damage.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "High-Impact Pulse Rifles may be a little less common in PvE but don't pass up this workhorse of a gun! Firefly shows up as a 3rd column perk, granting additional reload and a Solar explosion on a precision kill. This pairs amazingly with Hatchling or Elemental Honing (you get 2 stacks if you get kill from the solar explosion). Tear and Slice are both options for applying Sever, but that's about it... seriously, just get Firefly in that 3rd column!" Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed.

warlockmaggie (PvP / Controller): "Okay, this is where High-impact pulse rifles shine the most, ye olde Crucible. Take your pick of your favorite stat increasing perk in the 3rd column along with Headseeker or Closing Time for neutral game benefits or Desperado for kill chaining (psst, Firefly could work in column 3 with Desperado or Headseeker too). Since getting those two-burst kills requires all 6 shots to crit, focus on Stability and recoil via Barrel and Magazine to reduce flinch and tighten the burst." Recommended MW: Stability or Handling.
warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB): "" Recommended MW: Stability or Handling.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 141 from 27 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/51wAzrVIRJRsBHGTMCLZ0n?si=fade7bb615184d3e) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Strand build. Relentless returns as a Strand high-impact frame, offering bonus accuracy when ADSing and moving slowly or stationery. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are pretty average - d2foundry.gg calculates that 55 Range equates to 32.20m ADS and 20.13m hipfire before damage falloff, 49 Stability is ×1.1653 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 24 Handling is 0.47s ready, 0.41s ADS and 0.46s stow speed, and 36 Reload Speed is a 2.12s reload. Recoil Direction is 65, and Zoom is 18, and Magazine size is 27 (max 45). With the handling and Recoil Direction both needing love, there's really only one barrel perk to choose - Arrowhead Brake. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags are great or choose something that helps Reload Speed. For Strand builds, Tear or Slice in the first trait perk column provide an option to proc sever to reduce damage output from enemies to ×0.6 - Tear spreading sever in a AoE cloud on a crit kill, so good for tough groups of adds, or Slice to apply it up to three times on a hit after using your class ability, so better for single targets or bosses. In the second column Paracausal Affinity provides a ×1.2 damage boost for 6s following a darkness energy kill. The Crossing Over origin trait is a little strange, providing extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot, while Gravity Well can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Strand Tangles or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Relentless could overthrow Messenger for being the best legendary high-impact pulse in the game. Is it definitively better? No, nothing really is in this game. But it can compete for sure. Rapid Hit and Desperado are both great perks. Relentless being Strand allows it Slice and Hatchling that Messenger cannot get. Frenzy and Keep Away are both neutral perks that could do well with just about any combination of alternate perks." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "In PvP Relentless and Messenger really stand toe to toe. Neither are exceptionally better than the other, and both come with Rapid Hit and Headseeker or Keep Away. Zen Moment really shines on Relentless and possibly puts it over the edge. Whichever way you fall on the two pulses both will serve you extremely well." Recommended MW: Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 97 from 13 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4Uy7pfo5Thjtt2MF4vZitv?si=8e3adcb68d234006) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE pick for add clearing Minor Spec enemies in general content, particularly with a Strand subclass. Relentless returns as a Strand pulse rifle with below average stats that reveal its Season 1 origin. The recoil direction of 65 is vertical, if a little loose, so you either look to improve it further or, if you can handle the recoil, push out the range with your barrel perk. Any of the combat effect mag perks add further range in addition to the bullet behaviour, or Light Mag and Flared Magwell improve reload speed. You don't need to run a strand subclass but if you do then Slice and Hatchling can sever enemies to reduce their damage output (very useful in a boss fight to help your fireteam), and generate Threadlings for additional damage to synergise with your fragments. The Crossing Over origin trait is useful all around for PvE, with bumps to range and handling in the top half of a magazine, and a small 3% damage boost at the bottom. Recommended MW: Range, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.
